blocks.title: Guarding against pharming
blocks.text: To guard against pharming, check that a website's address is correct and secure, starting with https:// and showing a padlock in the address bar, before entering any details.
Effective online security combines several strategies, spam filters, antivirus software and careful cookie management, to cover different threats (Tip).
